reason: As written the falsifier does not discriminate. (1) prediction_if_true (IC/rho<1 and decreasing in p) contradicts the idea's own nongenericity_argument (N~p^2, rho~p, genus-2 IC O~(p): equal up to logs), so a 'true' outcome would be a toy log/constant artefact, not evidence; the two predictions are not mutually exclusive over p=4099..65537. (2) No null/control arm: needs a random genus-2 Jacobian over F_p of matched group order, and a generic E/F_{p^2} of matched order under rho, otherwise nothing separates 'Scholten structure' from 'any genus-2 Jacobian'. Since J(C)~Res E is an isogeny, structure cannot help or hurt IC beyond the isogeny map. (3) Metric 'GAE ratio' at a single size band is a stage ratio dominated by Gaudry constants (g!=2, factor-base/large-prime tuning); an exponent (log-log slope of counted ops vs log p) is the right structural quantity. (4) The DLP transfer is missing: E(F_{p^2}) target -> J(C)(F_p) needs the explicit 2-power-degree isogeny (or its dual); the cost and kernel loss (Transport conservation: |kappa|^{m-1}) must be counted, otherwise the comparison is IC-on-J vs rho-on-E for different instances. (5) Runnability: PARI has hyperellcharpoly but no genus-2 index calculus; Gaudry IC (Cantor arithmetic, degree-1 divisor factor base, relation search, sparse LA mod group order) must be hand-written in python/gp; at p=65537 the p x p dense LA (4e9 entries) or even sparse python LA is not feasible in 15 min; p<=2^14..2^15 is. Scholten gluing construction itself is implementable in gp (Weil restriction charpoly check T^4 - aT^2 + p^2 is cheap and structural). (6) Scaling to n=131/130-bit p: no. The idea self-declares it does not apply to prime-degree targets; E/F_{p^2} with p~2^65 is a different target class; toy result is calibration of tooling only, not evidence about the programme's targets (consistent with expected_class relabelling). Honest classification: relabelling/accounting; no obstruction crossed (B*D^2 vs N unchanged, GHS/Scholten known).
fix: Redesign as an accounting calibration with structural, counted metrics and a control. Arms: (A) Scholten C/F_p from E/F_{p^2} (E[2] rational) ; (B) control: random genus-2 Jacobian over F_p with |J| = |E(F_{p^2})| (same order, sieved by hyperellcharpoly / random hyperelliptic y^2=f(x) search); (C) rho on E(F_{p^2}) of the same order, with negation, counting group additions. Step 0 (structural, pass/fail): hyperellcharpoly(C) == T^4 - a*T^2 + p^2 where a = trace of E over F_{p^2}; also check #J(F_p)=#E(F_{p^2}) (isogeny invariance, Tate). Step 1: for p = 2^10,2^11,...,2^15 (>=10 curves per p per arm, fixed seeds) run identical Gaudry/GTTD genus-2 IC (factor base of degree-1 divisors, size chosen by the same rule, counted: relations needed, trials per relation, Cantor additions, sparse-matrix nnz and LA mult-ops) on arm A and arm B; rho on arm C counted in group additions (use sqrt(pi r/4) check). Step 2 (include transfer): carry the instance P,Q in E(F_{p^2}) to J via the explicit isogeny and count its cost and any kernel loss (>=1 factor 2^k); if no explicit isogeny map is built, state that the experiment is instance-mismatched and report only A vs B. Metric: fitted log-log slope s_IC of total counted ops vs log2 p, with bootstrap CI over curves, compared with rho slope 1.0; do not use a single ratio. Pre-registered predictions: TRUE-for-idea (structure helps) iff mean_ops(A)/mean_ops(B) differs from 1 by more than 3 sigma, or slope s_A < s_B - 2 sigma; FALSE (known accounting, expected) iff A/B within noise (~1.0) and s_IC within [0.9,1.2]+logs of rho slope, ratio IC/rho non-decreasing or flat after constants. Also report B*D^2/N for the factor base used (should be >= 1, i.e. generic). Budget: p<=2^15, 10 curves/arm, python3 + gp (hyperellcharpoly, ellinit over ffgen for E side), ~15 CPU-min; drop p=65537. Add one-line declaration: toy calibration only, no inference to p~2^130 or prime-degree n=131.
collisions: Prym same-field closure (scope: prime fields) and LEAD-TRF-second-torsion-direction: this idea sits on the extension-field side of both; no collision with their kill scope.
Transport conservation (kernel 2-primary isogeny changes decomposition count by |kappa|^{m-1}; the transfer step must be counted).
Frontier measurement: genus-2 / extension-field Weil-restriction families are listed as known algorithms fairly measured (GHS/Scholten/Gaudry); expected result duplicates them.
Generic oracle bound / non-genericity certificate B*D^2 << N: genus-2 Gaudry with GTTD balancing is Otilde(p) = rho on p^2; no sub-line.
